description:
Rank INDIVIDUAL devices by any battery metric — the general-purpose
leaderboard. Use it for 'which phones run hottest / last longest / charge
fastest', optionally narrowed to one brand and/or model. Returns at most
`limit` rows, so it answers superlative questions in a single small call
instead of enumerating the fleet.

Ranking is over each device's own lifetime aggregate. Pair the metric with
the right `order`: e.g. hottest = temperature_c + desc, fastest AC charging
= ac_charge_hours + asc, best battery life = discharge_hours + desc.

brand.description: Optional lowercase brand filter. When omitted, devices from any brand are ranked together.

metric.description: Which battery metric to rank on. One of: 'temperature_c' (mean battery temperature, C), 'max_temperature_c' / 'min_temperature_c' (hottest / coldest ever seen, C), 'battery_level_pct' (mean charge level, 0-100), 'discharge_hours' (hours to drain a full 100% - HIGHER means longer battery life), 'ac_charge_hours' / 'usb_charge_hours' / 'wireless_charge_hours' (hours to charge a full 100% on that source - LOWER means faster charging), 'awake_ratio' (fraction of time awake / screen-on, 0..1), 'snapshot_count' (how much data the device contributed), 'uptime_hours' (longest single uptime between reboots).

min_snapshots.description: Ignore devices with fewer snapshots than this. Defaults to 100, which filters out barely-sampled devices whose averages are meaningless. Lower it only when a query returns too few rows.

model.description: Optional model filter — matches resolved street name or raw Build.MODEL, case-insensitive. When omitted, no model filter applies.

order.description: 'desc' (default) ranks the highest values first, 'asc' the lowest. Pick the direction that matches the question: fastest charging is ac_charge_hours + asc; longest battery life is discharge_hours + desc.

name: top_devices

device_uid.description: Stable UUID identifying this device; feed it to `device_summary` or `device_ranking`.

last_seen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the device's most recent snapshot.

model.description: Resolved model name (street name), e.g. 'Galaxy S23'.

raw_model.description: Raw Build.MODEL identifier reported by the device.

snapshot_count.description: Snapshots behind this device's aggregate — low counts mean a noisy value.

url.description: Public BatterySnap page with this device's interactive battery history.

value.description: The requested metric's value for this device, in the unit documented for that metric.

title: Rank devices by metric
